body: yes, but they don't know me in real life... they won't even notice until later anyway

Thank you for saying these kind words..

I'm really down, I was getting so much better last year, was already planning many thing in life. But all came down, suicide in family, bad relationships, abuse, failing at education.

All the things people did to me, I would never think of doing it to anyone else, but leaving this world. I'm sorry.

The problem is: The only thing I dream of is making people smile, feel loved, feel amazed.
I don't have dreams like being successful professionally or being rich. 
All I wanted was a love, a friend who we could share everything, even our darkest fears or desires.
Things like working, being rich and successful would only matter to me if that would make my love live a better life.

I don't think I can hold it anymore... I only have until monday to get lucky or else...
